item.title: Hurricane Helene and the Provenance of Its Prediction
item.description: In December 2023, the TSR (Tropical Storm Risk) predicted tropical storm activity over the Atlantic to be 30% above 1991-2020 30-year norm, and 50% above the 1950-2023 year long-term norm (with large uncertainties). On 4th April 2024, the CSU’s forecast ranked 2024 as the 5th most active hurricane season in the satellite era (1966 - present). Citing warming sea temperatures and the development of La Nina over the summer (more details predicting more hurricanes due to trade winds and vertical wind shear).
